title: Hi, I'm Rakesh Poduval
text:
Palakkad, Kerala · Available worldwide, remotely
      Hi, I'm Rakesh Poduval
      Data Science Leader & Statistician
      I turn messy data into decisions. 16+ years across India and Switzerland, leading a team of 10+ data scientists, and happy to help with consulting, advice, training and talks in Statistics, R, Machine Learning and GenAI.

      About
      Most data problems aren't model problems.
      They're statistics, clarity and trust problems.
    
    
      I'm a statistician turned data science leader. Today I lead a team building Automated Valuation Models (AVMs) for Swiss real-estate finance, a regulated, business-critical setting where models have to be accurate and explainable.
      My strengths are statistics at depth (M.Sc. Statistics, mixed and hierarchical models at ETH Zurich), production R (internal packages served as REST APIs, Shiny apps, automated reports) and a growing practice in GenAI and AI agents. I also run workshops and talks at universities across Kerala.
       English · Hindi · Bengali · Malayalam
    
  



  
    How I can help
    How I can help
    
      
        
        Consulting
        Stuck on a data or business challenge? Sometimes you just need someone who has seen it before. Forecasting, pricing, modelling and GenAI, with honest, practical advice.
      
      
        
        Training & workshops
        Hands-on sessions in Statistics, R Programming, Machine Learning, and GenAI and AI Agents, plus Data Literacy for managers. For institutions, teams and freshers. Online or in person in Kerala, from one day to multi-week programmes.
      
      
        
        Talks
        Conferences, institutions and events. Practical statistics, honest GenAI lessons and what it takes to lead data teams.

    Projects
    Things I've built
    Open-source work on GitHub, built to learn, teach and show how I approach problems: small, readable, tested and runnable. Everything below is public.
    
      
        
        AI Agent Playground 
        A layered, teachable blueprint for building AI agents. FastAPI services are exposed as MCP tools, and an agent calls them in a tool-calling loop with conversation memory (in-process or Redis), then publishes itself over the A2A protocol with an Agent Card and bearer auth. Provider-agnostic (NVIDIA, Ollama, LiteLLM, OpenAI), with tests, a handbook and a learning path.
        PythonMCPA2AFastAPIRedis
      
      
        
        LLM Innovation Hub 
        A sandbox for trying and comparing the latest LLMs. One docker compose up gives Open WebUI for chatting and a LiteLLM proxy that fronts NVIDIA NIM, Groq, Mistral and Hugging Face behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A Python harness runs the same prompts across every provider for side-by-side comparison. Optional .NET Aspire dashboard.
        DockerLiteLLMOpen WebUILLM evaluation
      
      
        
        A coding agent in ~120 lines of R 
        Shows how little it takes to build an agent. Built on ellmer and the Groq API, the LLM reads, searches, edits and writes files and runs shell commands in your project, iterating until the task is done. Useful as a teaching example for R users moving into GenAI.
        RellmerTool useAgents
      
      
        
        Multi-agent AI ecosystem
        Collaborating agents built with LangGraph and CrewAI that plan, reason and use tools to solve compound tasks no single prompt can handle.
        LangGraphCrewAIAgents
      
      
        
        Product insight generator
        A prompt-chained summariser that turns raw customer reviews into structured pros and cons, so teams can see what customers actually say without reading thousands of reviews.
        GenAINLPPrompt chaining
      
      
        
        resquisse and R in Docker 
        A free Shiny chart builder (drag and drop, no R install) built on esquisse and deployed on shinyapps.io. The same app, plus plumber (REST APIs), Rserve and Radiant, is packaged as ready-to-run Docker images on Docker Hub (rdockers).
        RShinyDockerplumber
      
      
        
        rputils 
        My personal toolbox of R utilities for day-to-day work, still a work in progress. Today it has a describe() for quick descriptive statistics, diffs of text files, Excel workbooks, functions and RData objects, and helpers to load single objects from RData files and run scripts from the shell.
        R packageroxygen2Work in progress
      
      
        
        EasyCalculator and rshinytool 
        EasyCalculator is an R package for Indian income tax: bulk calculation for any financial year from 2022, old vs new regime comparisons, summaries and plots. rshinytool demonstrates how to ship Shiny apps (such as k-means clustering) inside an R package.
        R packageFinanceShiny
      
    
    
      Want to build something together?
      I'm glad to collaborate on open-source work, contribute to R and GenAI tooling, co-teach a workshop or review an approach you're stuck on. If you have an idea, an issue to raise or a project that could use a statistician's eye, open an issue on any repo above or write to me.
